title: QEx EDGE/VERT QPort prev/next ordering must be 3D-CCW, not insertion order
description:
Surfaced during PATCH-61. Fixed three QEdge tracing bugs and Hand-30k went 0 → 482 quads. metriko produces 2339 on the same input — we still have a structural gap.

Empirical sweep of COLLINEAR_EPS:
  EPS=1e-4: edge QVerts=1   QEdges=1119 quads=482  (best)
  EPS=1e-3: edge QVerts=29  QEdges=1122 quads=465
  EPS=3e-3: edge QVerts=68  QEdges=1126 quads=420
  EPS=1e-2: edge QVerts=221 QEdges=1227 quads=314
  EPS=2e-2: edge QVerts=442 QEdges=1447 quads=210

Adding EDGE QVerts INCREASES QEdge count but DECREASES quad count. The 4-cycle walk in QuadFaceGenerator follows port.prev each hop. For face-source QVerts the prev/next ring is the natural cardinal-CCW order (+u, +v, -u, -v), which is correct. For EDGE-source and VERT-source QVerts we use insertion order from the (face, dir-cardinal) enumeration, which isn't guaranteed to be CCW around the QVert in 3D space. That breaks 4-cycle walks: prev hops to the wrong port and the cycle never closes.

Fix: when emitting EDGE/VERT ports, sort them by polar angle in 3D space around the QVert position before the cyclicLink call. Reference: metriko's gen_q_port.h emits ports in the natural one-ring/edge walk order, which IS CCW because the half-edge data structure walks CCW.

Also worth checking: the EDGE QVert COUNT on Hand-30k is far below metriko's count of integer-on-edge points. If our EDGE pass missed many at EPS=1e-4 (only 1 found), but found 442 at EPS=2e-2, the right threshold is somewhere in between AND the cycle ordering must be fixed first.
definition-of-done: MetrikoStageRegressionTest.stage2UvsThroughQexProducesQuads reports our_quad_count > 1170 (>50% of metriko's 2339). Existing PATCH-43/58/61 toy tests still pass. Final COLLINEAR_EPS picked for accuracy + lowest false-positive rate.
testing-plan: 1. Order EDGE-source ports CCW in 3D. Re-run regression at EPS=1e-2; expect quad count to increase (not decrease). 2. Same for VERT-source. 3. Tune COLLINEAR_EPS for max quad output.
